verse.verse_1: Has the news of the overwhelming event reached you?
verse.verse_2: Some faces that Day shall be downcast with fear,
verse.verse_4: they shall burn in a Scorching Fire;
verse.verse_5: their drink shall be from a boiling spring.
verse.verse_6: They shall have no food except bitter dry thorns
verse.verse_7: that will neither nourish nor satisfy their hunger.
verse.verse_8: On that very Day some faces shall be radiant with joy,
verse.verse_10: They will be in a lofty Garden
verse.verse_11: wherein they shall hear no vain talk.
verse.verse_12: In it there shall be a flowing spring,
verse.verse_17: Do (these unbelievers) not observe the camels: how they were created?
verse.verse_18: And the sky: how it was raised high?
verse.verse_19: And the mountains: how they were fixed?
verse.verse_20: And the earth: how it was spread out?
verse.verse_21: So render good counsel, for you are simply required to counsel,
verse.verse_22: and are not invested with the authority to compel them.
verse.verse_23: But whoever will turn away (from the Truth),
verse.verse_24: Allah will chastise him with the most terrible chastisement.
verse.verse_25: Surely to Us is their return;
verse.verse_26: and then it is for Us to call them to account.
